scratch_experiment.reason: removes heap allocations, but no consistent throughput improvement and adoption requires maintaining a source fork of rav1e (~11MB source); small fixed scratch also adds4KiB stack per active inverse transform

asm.maintenance: existing rav1e0.8.1 native SIMD only; no fork/vendor or version switch. Adds nasm-rs0.3.2 build dependency; NASM>=2.15 plus native toolchain onx86_64. RuntimeCPUdispatch remains upstream. Binaries/RSS increase explicitly measured.
asm.pixel_type: u8 only for8-bit with featureasm;10/12bit and portable build retainu16
asm.material_new_rationale: Unlike previously rejected u8-only scalar specialization, native SIMD dispatch selects low/high-depth kernels by pixel type. Raw enablingASM with8bitu16 changed bitstreams; correctu8 SIMD routing restores complete baseline bitstreams and produces substantial gains.

dispatch_probe.note: Raw u16 ASM variant is not shipped. Source inverse dispatch sends U16 depths other than10 through HBD12 table; this path observation is not claimed as a complete isolated upstream root-cause proof. Required frozen regression rejects the observed incompatible variant.
